lines.en: label predormwars3:
scene omganotherwaralready1
: Hear ye, hear ye! Uta-chan hereby calls into order discussion surrounding the latest installment of {i}her{/i} favorite contest {i}and{/i} yours...
lines.zh: : 肃静，肃静！Uta 在此宣布，关于{i}她{/i}最爱的、{i}也{/i}是诸位最爱的比赛之最新一届的讨论，正式开始……

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready2
: THE SUPER MEGA ULTIMATE DORM WARS ROUND THREE!!!
lines.zh: : 超级无敌究极宿舍大战 第三轮！！！

lines.en: : {i}Ahem...{/i}
: AND ALSO MAKOTO IS BACK AND ENTHUSIASTICALLY IN CHARGE OF THE FIRST FLOOR AGAIN!!! YEAAAAAH!!!
lines.zh: : 另外，Makoto 也回来了，并再次热情满满地接管了一楼！！！耶————！

lines.en: Something feels off.
lines.zh: 有什么地方不对劲。

lines.en: The gaps between our bigger events are getting smaller and smaller...and if what I heard from Imani earlier is right, it means-
lines.zh: 大型活动之间的间隔越来越短了……如果我先前从 Imani 那里听来的没错，那就意味着——

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready3
: Additionally, given the {i}totally not suspicious{/i} timing of this event, we’ve decided to combine it with our {i}totally not suspicious{/i} annual beach trip as well.
lines.zh: : 另外，鉴于本次活动这个{i}完全不可疑{/i}的时机，我们决定把它和我们同样{i}完全不可疑{/i}的年度海滩之行合并举办。

lines.en: : That’s right, Makoto. And ignoring how {i}totally not suspicious{/i} your insistence on things not being suspicious is, it falls on the two of us to assign the competitions and competitors.
lines.zh: : 说得好，Makoto。而且先不提你一个劲儿强调「不可疑」这件事本身有多{i}可疑{/i}，分配比赛项目和参赛选手的重任，就落在我们两个人身上了。

lines.en: It’s not just the Dorm War that’s showing up early...it’s everything.
lines.zh: 不只是宿舍大战来得太早……是所有事都来得太早。

lines.en: Well, everything {i}so far.{/i} But who’s to say that this year’s competition won’t end with yet another jump to Christmas or Halloween or...whatever the universe wants to throw at us next.
lines.zh: 好吧，是{i}到目前为止{/i}的一切。可谁又能保证今年的比赛不会又一次跳到圣诞节、万圣节，或者……随便宇宙接下来想砸给我们的什么东西。

lines.en: Makoto knows it too...yet she’s jovially pushing forward in complete disregard for how much this throws our lives off.
lines.zh: Makoto 心里也清楚……可她还是一副乐呵呵的样子往前冲，全然不顾这会把我们的生活搅成什么样。

lines.en: And as much as I wish I could join her in her carelessness, I can’t. Especially not with Ayane, Maya, and Ami all acting much different than normal lately.
lines.zh: 我也想像她那样没心没肺，可我做不到。尤其最近 Ayane、Maya 和 Ami 的表现都跟平时差得太远。

lines.en: Is it really possible for me to just sit back and enjoy this next movement in my life?
lines.zh: 我真的能就这么袖手旁观，去享受人生的下一个乐章吗？

lines.en: Or is this one more log to stoke the flames of chaos that creep closer to my home every single day?
lines.zh: 还是说，这只是又一捆柴，投进那团每天都在向我家里逼近的混乱之火？

lines.en: The season alone is hot enough without the added heat-
lines.zh: 光是这个季节本身就已经够热了，不需要再添这把火——

lines.en: And I can only imagine the fires to come if they are not doused immediately.
lines.zh: 而若不能立刻浇灭，接下来会烧成什么样，我连想都不愿想。

lines.en: Godspeed, endless summer.
lines.zh: 一路走好，无尽的夏天。

lines.en: May the winter come and swallow you whole.
lines.zh: 愿冬天降临，把你整个吞没。

lines.en: : Now, there is one elephant in the room that needs to be addressed before-
lines.zh: : 那么，在开始之前，有一头房间里的大象需要先解决——

lines.en: : Where?!
lines.zh: : 在哪儿？！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready4
: {i}Miku, come on...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Miku，别闹了……{/i}

lines.en: : Show me the elephant, Makoto! Show it to me!
lines.zh: : 把大象指给我看，Makoto！指给我看！

lines.en: : It’s a...never mind. What I’m trying to say is that there’s still the matter of last year’s winner not receiving any sort of prize as of yet.
lines.zh: : 那是一头……算了。我想说的是，去年的获胜者到目前为止还没拿到任何奖品，这件事还悬着。

lines.en: if dormwar2tie == True:
: Wait...didn't last year's contest end in a tie?
lines.zh: : 等等……去年的比赛不是平局收场吗？

lines.en: : Maybe in {i}this{/i} timeline. But who's to say there's not a {i}second{/i} timeline running alongside this one where that {i}didn't{/i} happen?!
lines.zh: : 也许在{i}这条{/i}时间线里是吧。可谁敢说没有{i}第二{/i}条与这条并行的时间线，在那儿结果{i}并不是{/i}这样呢？！

lines.en: : That just sounds like a convenient excuse to not write additional dialogue for a scenario that impacted less than 1%% of the player base.
lines.zh: : 听着只是个方便的借口——为了一个影响不到 1%% 玩家的剧情，懒得多写几段对话罢了。

lines.en: : The writer is probably exhausted, Kirin! You wouldn't understand!
lines.zh: : 作者八成已经累垮了，Kirin！你不会懂的！

lines.en: : {i}Ahem...{/i}Uta, could you please take control of the room back now?
lines.zh: : {i}咳咳……{/i}Uta，能麻烦你把场子收回去吗？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready5
: Makoto and I thought long and hard about what to do about this, and we came up with all sorts of options that both did and {i}didn’t{/i} involve Sensei.
lines.zh: : 关于这件事怎么办，Makoto 和我冥思苦想了很久，想出了各种牵涉到老师、以及{i}不牵涉{/i}到老师的方案。

lines.en: Oh, maybe I’ll be in luck and not get targeted this year.
lines.zh: 哦，也许我今年走运，不会被盯上。

lines.en: : But of course we had to throw away all of the non-Sensei ideas since, let’s face it, we know what 90%% of the class is really after.
lines.zh: : 但那些不牵涉老师的点子当然全得扔掉，因为说实话，全班 90%% 的人真正想追的是什么，我们心知肚明。

lines.en: Or not.
lines.zh: 看来不是。

lines.en: : The thing is, with the next Dorm Wars just a short while away, we didn’t have time to set up some sort of fun excursion or anything like that as a true {i}reward{/i} for last year’s winning floor.
lines.zh: : 问题是，下一届宿舍大战转眼就到，我们没时间为去年获胜的楼层安排一次什么有趣的远足之类的，当作真正的{i}奖励{/i}。

lines.en: : So instead, we’ve decided to create both a {i}brand new{/i} special reward for this year’s winner AND give the winner of last year’s Dorm Wars an extra 2-point handicap coming into this year’s competition.
lines.zh: : 所以我们决定双管齐下：既为今年的获胜者设立一个{i}全新{/i}的特别奖励，又给去年宿舍大战的获胜者在今年的比赛中追加 2 分的优势。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready6
: Makoto, would you like to tell the class what that brand new special reward is?
lines.zh: : Makoto，你愿意向大家宣布这个全新的特别奖励是什么吗？

lines.en: : I’d be honored, Uta.
lines.zh: : 这是我的荣幸，Uta。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready7
: This year, the winning floor-
lines.zh: : 今年，获胜的楼层——

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready8
: GETS TO HAVE A SLEEPOVER AT SENSEI’S HOUSE! WOOOOOO!
lines.zh: : 可以在老师家过夜！哇哦哦哦哦！

lines.en: : Why...did you even ask me if I wanted to tell everyone if you were just going to do that?
lines.zh: : 那你干嘛还问我想不想由我来宣布……你自己不就说了吗？

lines.en: : Couldn’t help it! Woooooooo!
lines.zh: : 忍不住嘛！哇哦哦哦哦哦哦！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready9
: Uhh...
: Not excited for the new prize, Senpai?
lines.zh: : 对新奖品不怎么兴奋啊，Senpai？

lines.en: : Specifically, I’m concerned about how Ami is going to handle this and how they managed to arrange this prize without running it by her.
lines.zh: : 具体来说，我担心的是 Ami 会怎么应对，还有她们是怎么做到不跟她通个气就把这个奖品定下来的。

lines.en: : We decided it by ourselves last night without talking to Ami! Wooooo!
lines.zh: : 我们昨晚自己决定的，没跟 Ami 商量！哇哦哦哦！

lines.en: : LIKE HECK YOU DID! The only person sleeping at my house is me! And also obviously Sensei because it is his house too!
lines.zh: : 你们放屁！能在我家睡觉的只有我！当然还有老师，因为那也是他家！

lines.en: : Oi! I’ve slept at yer’ house on several occasions! What’s the problem this time?
lines.zh: : 喂！我在你家睡过好几回了！这次又怎么了？

lines.en: : The...context! I think.
lines.zh: : 是……场合！我想。

lines.en: : I don’t know! I’m just mad nobody talked to me about this!
lines.zh: : 我不知道！我就是气，没人跟我商量过这件事！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready10
: You know, you don’t look all that excited either. And you seemed to really like this Dorm Wars thing last year.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你看着也不怎么兴奋啊。去年你不是挺喜欢这个宿舍大战的吗？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready11
: Yeah...I did.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我是挺喜欢的。

lines.en: : It’s not really that part I’m worried about...
lines.zh: : 我担心的其实不是那个部分……

lines.en: : Then...the beach?
lines.zh: : 那么……是海滩？

lines.en: : If you’re worried about being seen in a swimsuit now that it’s actually hot out-
lines.zh: : 如果你是在担心天热了以后穿泳装被人看见——

lines.en: : Let's not do this right now, Senpai. The girls are...trying to do their thing.
lines.zh: : 这个咱们现在就别聊了，Senpai。姑娘们……正忙着呢。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready12
: Oh, also, we’re axing the date war this year so nobody winds up getting...well, {i}axed.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，今年我们把约会战争砍掉了，免得最后有人被……嗯，{i}砍掉{/i}。

lines.en: : It was for the safety of everyone. We’re sure you all understand.
lines.zh: : 这是为了大家的安全。相信各位都能理解。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready13
: Bullshit! The date war is a Dorm Wars tradition and deserves to stay in the competition! We won’t stand for this!
lines.zh: : 放屁！约会战争是宿舍大战的传统，理应保留在赛程里！我们绝不答应！

lines.en: : What are you so upset about? It’s not like you’d be allowed to compete again in the first place. You were already in the first date war thing.
lines.zh: : 你这么激动干什么？反正你本来也不可能被允许再参赛。第一次约会战争你早参加过了。

lines.en: : Shut up, whore. There was no rule about the same person not being allowed to compete twice.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，婊子。根本没有哪条规定说同一个人不能参赛两次。

lines.en: : Actually, in page seven of the Dorm Wars digital handbook in the new Dorm Wars app, you’ll see that there {i}was{/i} a rule prohibiting just that.
lines.zh: : 其实，在新版宿舍大战 app 的电子版《宿舍大战手册》第七页上，你会看到确实有这么一条规定，禁止的正{i}是{/i}这件事。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready14
: Oh. Well, whatever then. It’s not like I actually care or anything.
lines.zh: : 哦。那算了。反正我也不是真的在乎什么的。

lines.en: : Bruh.
lines.zh: : 兄弟。

lines.en: : You doin’ okay, Io? Seems like you’re about to catch on fire or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Io？看着像是要自燃了还是怎么的。

lines.en: : Probably because I {i}am.{/i} Why did everyone decide to gather around {i}my{/i} desk when I’m the one person who doesn’t want anyone near her?
lines.zh: : 大概因为我是{i}真的{/i}要烧起来了。明摆着我是全班最不想让人靠近的人，大家为什么非要围到{i}我的桌边{/i}来？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready15
: Your desk is prime real estate in situations like this. You’re the closest to the center of the classroom.
lines.zh: : 这种情况下，你的桌子可是黄金地段。你离教室正中心最近。

lines.en: : Thank you for reminding me to choose a new seat. Shouldn’t be hard since no one here knows how to stay in theirs.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你提醒我换个座位。应该不难，反正这儿没一个人懂得待在自己的位子上。

lines.en: : Apologies for interrupting, but I would like to inquire on whether or not I’d be able to compete in something that does not directly involve our teacher this year.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打断一下，我想请问，今年我能不能参加一个不直接涉及老师的项目。

lines.en: : Such a thing seems to be even more dangerous today than it was last year, and that is saying quite a lot.
lines.zh: : 这种事在今天似乎比去年更危险了，而去年就已经够危险了。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready12
: Excellent question, Touka!
lines.zh: : 问得好，Touka！

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : N...No? Just like that?
lines.zh: : 不……不行？就这么干脆？

lines.en: : We have you competing against Ami in a competition to see who can take better care of Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我们安排你和 Ami 比一场，看谁更能把老师照顾好。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready16
: Fantastic.
lines.zh: : 好极了。

lines.en: : Do I accept my point now or later? Asking for all of the first floor.
lines.zh: : 那我这 1 分是现在收还是待会儿收？我代表全一楼问的。

lines.en: : Hey! Don’t count Touka out just yet! You might not have recognized it since you don’t ever talk to her, but she’s got intense mom-vibes!
lines.zh: : 喂！别这么快就把 Touka 排除在外啊！你可能看不出来，毕竟你从来不跟她说话，但她身上的妈妈气场可强了！

lines.en: : That’s right, Ami. As representative of the first floor, I’ll have you know that Touka is-
lines.zh: : 说得对，Ami。作为一楼的代表，我得让你知道 Touka 是——

lines.en: : Blah, blah, blah. Easiest competition of my life. Might as well have us compete to see who the best Ami is.
lines.zh: : 废话连篇。我这辈子最轻松的一场比赛。干脆让我们比谁才是最棒的 Ami 算了。

lines.en: : Why do you seem so down, Touka? I think you’ve got a solid chance at this.
lines.zh: : 你为什么看起来这么失落，Touka？我觉得你赢面不小啊。

lines.en: : She’s probably down because she’s competing to see how well she can take care of our fucking weirdo teacher and she’s one of the few who isn’t dead set on humping him to death.
lines.zh: : 她失落，大概是因为要比的是谁更能照顾好我们那个该死的变态老师，而她是少数几个没打算把他操到死的人之一。

lines.en: : I would just like one opportunity to show the class that I am more than you all seem to think I am. I have so many talents and never any opportunities to showcase them.
lines.zh: : 我只是想要一个机会，向全班证明我不像你们想的那么简单。我有那么多才能，却从来没有展示的机会。

lines.en: : And last year, I didn’t even get to compete. I just got to stand in a shed and listen to my mother provide sexual education to an adult male.
lines.zh: : 而且去年，我连参赛都没捞着。我只是站在小屋里，听我妈给一个成年男性上性教育课。

lines.en: : You think {i}that’s{/i} bad? I got jipped out of 10 G’s {i}and{/i} lost a company. Shit’s weak.
lines.zh: : 你觉得{i}那{/i}很惨？我被人坑了一万块，{i}还{/i}赔进去一家公司。弱爆了。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready17
: Hey, wait a fuckin’ second! Wasn’t it your bratty sister who bought my idea without-
lines.zh: : 喂，等等！难道不是你那个臭屁妹妹擅自买走了我的点子——

lines.en: : Oh, and Yumi and Tsuneyo are {i}also{/i} competing to see who can take better care of Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦，对了，Yumi 和 Tsuneyo {i}也{/i}要比一场，看谁更能把老师照顾好！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready18
: Sorry, hold on a sec.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，等一下。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready19
: THE FUCK DID YOU JUST SAY, SHRIMP?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈刚才说什么，矮子？！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready20
: To be more specific, you’ll be competing in the first ever {i}two-part{/i} Dorm Wars competition!
lines.zh: : 说得更具体一点，你们将参加宿舍大战史上第一场分{i}两个部分{/i}进行的比赛！

lines.en: : {i}And{/i} you’ll be stuck with Sensei for the {i}entire weekend!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}而且{/i}你们要跟老师{i}整整{/i}黏一个周末！

lines.en: : Probably even while he sleeps!
lines.zh: : 大概连他睡觉的时候都黏在一起！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready21
: Jeez. Didn’t think I’d ever see an expression like that on {i}you{/i} of all people.
lines.zh: : 天哪。真没想到会在{i}你{/i}这种人脸上看到这种表情。

lines.en: : She’ll be fine. She probs just shut her brain off as a form of protection or something. Like that thing kids do when they’re being abused or whatever.
lines.zh: : 她没事的。她大概只是把脑子关掉了当作自我保护之类的。就像小孩被虐待时会做的那种事。

lines.en: : Damn, Chika. No need to get all dark on us like that.
lines.zh: : 靠，Chika。没必要突然这么阴暗吧。

lines.en: : When did I give you permission to speak to me?
lines.zh: : 我什么时候允许你跟我说话了？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready22
: I’m back. What happened?
lines.zh: : 我回来了。发生了什么？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure. We haven’t gotten the full details yet. But it is presumably something where you need to watch Sensei sleep.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定。我们还没听到完整的细则。不过大概是那种需要你盯着老师睡觉的活儿。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready21
: Huh.
: This is actually kinda cute.
lines.zh: : 这其实还挺可爱的。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready23
: Please provide further information on how I am meant to slaughter my opponent and obtain the W for the girls back home. Hoo-rah.
lines.zh: : 请进一步说明，我该如何痛击对手，为家里的姑娘们拿下这场胜利。吼-啦。

lines.en: : Will do! Take it away, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 没问题！交给你了，Makoto！

lines.en: : Are you going to just interrupt me this time as well?
lines.zh: : 这次你也要打断我吗？

lines.en: : I would never. Please, proceed. Especially since you’re the one who came up with this competition and I still don’t really get it.
lines.zh: : 我绝不会。请讲。尤其是这个项目本来就是你提出来的，而我到现在都还没太搞懂。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready24
: Essentially, you’ll be working with Noriko in a battle to protect Sensei from being hugged.
lines.zh: : 简单来说，你要和 Noriko 组队，在一场「保卫老师不被抱」的战斗里合作。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready25
: So basically, you’ll be a bodyguard. If you can prevent anyone from getting to him over the course of the Dorm Wars, your team will earn a point.
lines.zh: : 也就是说，你相当于保镖。只要你能在这次宿舍大战期间阻止任何人接近他，你们队就得 1 分。

lines.en: : But it’ll most likely wind up being two points if Noriko succeeds as the attacker thingy, right?
lines.zh: : 不过如果 Noriko 那个「进攻方什么的」成功了，多半就是 2 分了吧？

lines.en: : Correct, unless the competition ends in a stalemate and neither side has hugged Sensei by the time all of the other contests have ended.
lines.zh: : 没错，除非比赛以僵局收场，等其他所有项目都结束时双方谁也没抱到老师。

lines.en: : In that case, both defenders will gain one point and both attackers will gain zero, essentially nullifying both competitions.
lines.zh: : 那种情况下，两名防守方各得 1 分，两名进攻方各得 0 分，等于两场比赛都作废。

lines.en: : Well, who the fuck is my partner if Noodle-Girl gets to team up with Pinkie? Cause if it ain’t Chika, I ain’t doin’ it.
lines.zh: : 那我他妈的搭档是谁啊？面条妹居然能跟粉毛组队？如果不是 Chika，我可不干。

lines.en: : The person competing against Noriko as an attacker is...
lines.zh: : 作为进攻方与 Noriko 对决的人是……

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready26
: Oh, you’ve gotta be fucking kidding me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈是在跟我开玩笑吧。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready27
: Hah...
: Guess we’re enemies now, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来我们现在是敌人了，是吧？

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : The fuck you look all down for? You get to compete in a fucking stupid ass hug-fight or some shit. Ain’t you, like, “in love” with our teacher or whatever? Shouldn’t you be happy?
lines.zh: : 你摆这张臭脸给谁看？你能参加一场蠢得要命的抱人比赛什么的了。你不是，那个，「爱着」我们老师吗？不该高兴才对？

lines.en: : I’m not doing it.
lines.zh: : 我不干。

lines.en: : It’s a lot more complicated than that...
lines.zh: : 事情比那要复杂得多……

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready28
: You all know damn well I want nothing to do with Noriko. And that includes wiping the floor with her in some stupid competition. Switch me with someone else.
lines.zh: : 你们心里都清楚，我一点都不想跟 Noriko 扯上关系。那也包括在这种愚蠢的比赛里把她打得落花流水。给我换个对手。

lines.en: : No can do, Princess Maya! Your name’s already written down on the thingy! So all that’s left for you to do is fight away the strongest girl in the class and hug the teacher!
lines.zh: : 不行哦，Maya 公主！你的名字已经写在那张纸上了！所以你剩下的选择只有：干翻班上最强的那个女生，然后去抱老师！

lines.en: : Wait, hold on. Ain’t Ponytail on {i}my{/i} team? Why’s she gotta fight away me? Am I not understanding the contest or some shit?
lines.zh: : 等等，等一下。马尾不是{i}我这一队{/i}的吗？她干嘛要拦着我？是我没搞懂比赛规则还是怎么的？

lines.en: : Aww, how cute. She thinks I was talking about her.
lines.zh: : 哇，真可爱。她以为我说的是她。

lines.en: : Yo! Come over here and say that to my face!
lines.zh: : 喂！有种过来当着我的面再说一遍！

lines.en: : Ah! Makoto, protect me!
lines.zh: : 啊！Makoto，保护我！

lines.en: : Think you can do it, Maya? You probably don’t have to, like...{i}be around{/i} Noriko. You can just be all sneaky and stuff and hug Sensei while no one else is watching.
lines.zh: : 你觉得你能行吗，Maya？你大概也不用……非要{i}待在{/i} Noriko 附近。你可以偷偷摸摸的，趁没人看见的时候把老师抱了。

lines.en: : You’re good at that, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你很擅长那个吧？

lines.en: : I don’t want to compete {i}at all.{/i} It’s a stupid idea for a competition and-
lines.zh: : 我{i}根本{/i}就不想参赛。这个点子蠢透了，而且——

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready29
: Wait, can you repeat that last part?
lines.zh: : 等等，你能把最后那句再说一遍吗？

lines.en: : Hm? I just said you should be sneaky or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我只是说你可以偷偷摸摸什么的。

lines.en: : It should be easy.
lines.zh: : 应该很容易。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready30
: Of course, no Dorm Wars would be complete without your team captains competing! So me and Makoto will let ya know what we’re going to be battling in right now!
lines.zh: : 当然了，没有队长对决的宿舍大战是不完整的！所以我和 Makoto 现在就告诉大家我们要比什么！

lines.en: : Makoto and I.
lines.zh: : 是 Makoto 和我。

lines.en: : And hopefully it ain’t grammar!
lines.zh: : 但愿不是语法！

lines.en: : Isn’t.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready31
: Why you always gotta do me like this?
lines.zh: : 你干嘛老是这么对我？

lines.en: : Habit, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概是习惯了吧。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready30
: But that’s not important right now!
lines.zh: : 不过那都不重要！

lines.en: : Chika Chosokabe! I’m calling you out!
lines.zh: : Chika Chosokabe！我要点你的名！

lines.en: : You and me! The beach! Swimsuits! Maybe a romantic candlelit dinner or something?! Who knows?!
lines.zh: : 你和我！海滩！泳装！也许再来一顿浪漫的烛光晚餐什么的？！谁知道呢？！

lines.en: : What Uta means to say is that the two of you will be competing in a gravure-style swimsuit competition judged by Sensei and Miss Imai!
lines.zh: : Uta 想说的是，你们两个要比的是写真风格的泳装对决，由老师和 Imai 小姐担任评委！

lines.en: : Hey, that doesn’t sound borderline illegal at all! Great idea, guys!
lines.zh: : 嘿，这听着一点都不像是在违法边缘试探啊！好主意，各位！

lines.en: : Don’t wait until now to get involved again. Let me have this.
lines.zh: : 别等到现在才又插一脚进来。让我把这句说完。

lines.en: : You’re on, Uta! Can’t wait to see what you’ve got in store!
lines.zh: : 来啊，Uta！我等不及想看看你准备了什么！

lines.en: : You can see anything you want, whenever you want! And please forget I just said that!
lines.zh: : 你想看什么都可以，什么时候都行！请当我刚才那句没说过！

lines.en: : As for me, I’ll be competing against Kirin!
lines.zh: : 至于我，我要和 Kirin 比！

lines.en: : Oooh, nice! In what? Underwear modeling? A tickle fight? Seeing how many marshmallows we can fit in our mouth?
lines.zh: : 哦哦，不错！比什么？内衣走秀？挠痒痒大战？比谁嘴里能塞更多棉花糖？

lines.en: : Better!
lines.zh: : 更棒！

lines.en: : Fishing!
lines.zh: : 钓鱼！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready32
: ...Fishing?
: {i}That’s{/i} our super-hype contest?
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}就是我们超级劲爆的比赛项目？

lines.en: : Uta and Chika get to wear bathing suits and model for our teachers and {i}I{/i} get to fucking {i}fish?{/i}
lines.zh: : Uta 和 Chika 可以穿着泳装给我们的老师摆姿势，而{i}我就{/i}他妈的要去{i}钓鱼{/i}？

lines.en: : I’m calling bullshit. Garbage show-runners. It’s the last season of Dexter all over again.
lines.zh: : 我说这是扯淡。一群垃圾编剧。简直就是《Dexter》最后一季重演。

lines.en: : I’ll trade places with you. That’s the only competition so far that hasn’t sounded like a colossal pain in the ass.
lines.zh: : 我跟你换。这是到目前为止唯一一个听起来不是巨他妈麻烦的项目。

lines.en: : On another note, Io will be competing against Miku in a contest to see who can build a better raft!
lines.zh: : 另外，Io 要和 Miku 比一场，看谁能造出更好的木筏！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready33
: Never mind. I want the one I actually got instead. You can go back to not existing.
lines.zh: : 当我没说。我还是想要我自己那个吧。你可以继续当透明人了。

lines.en: : Hah...
scene omganotherwaralready34
: Mind takin’ it a little easy on me? Building stuff is kinda like, your whole thing, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 能对我手下留情一点吗？做东西这种事，算是你的老本行了吧？

lines.en: : I'd say it's a tie between that and self-deprecation. But frankly, I don’t know what sort of nonsense is going on with the competitions this year if we’re handing out matchups as unbalanced as this.
lines.zh: : 要我说，那和自嘲算是并列第一。不过说真的，今年这些比赛到底在搞什么鬼，居然能排出这么不平衡的对阵。

lines.en: : It would be, like...me competing against you in soccer or something like that.
lines.zh: : 就好比……我和你比踢足球之类的。

lines.en: : Ain’t really doin’ much for my confidence here, Io.
lines.zh: : 你这可一点都没帮我找回信心啊，Io。

lines.en: : Sorry, there’s just no way you can win.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你是真的赢不了。

lines.en: : Something horrible would have to happen to me.
lines.zh: : 除非我身上发生了什么可怕的事。

lines.en: : Actually, something horrible will probably happen to me and you’ll probably win. I think I just jinxed myself.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我身上大概真的会发生什么可怕的事，然后你就赢了。我觉得我刚给自己立了个 flag。

lines.en: : {i}I’m{/i} rooting for you, Miku. I’m sure your raft will be great and I’d love to take a ride on it once it’s done.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}支持你，Miku。我相信你的木筏会很棒，造好之后我还想上去坐坐。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready35
: {i}Bet that’s not all you’d like to take a ride on, slut.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我打赌你想坐的可不止那个吧，荡妇。{/i}

lines.en: : What was that, Io? It’s a little hard to hear you over how absolutely fucking unbearable you are.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么，Io？你实在太他妈让人受不了了，我有点听不清。

lines.en: : That doesn’t even make sense. But at least the latter part was right.
lines.zh: : 这话根本不通。不过后半句倒是对的。

lines.en: : It ain’t nice to talk down on others like that, Io. Chika’s good people.
lines.zh: : 别这么贬低别人，Io。Chika 是个好人。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready36
: Thank you, Miku. I knew I could count on you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Miku。我就知道能指望你。

lines.en: : But if you don’t talk down on people, how else are you supposed to feel good about yourself?
lines.zh: : 可要是不贬低别人，那要靠什么让自己感觉良好呢？

lines.en: : Idunno...do somethin’ you’re good at maybe?
lines.zh: : 不晓得……也许做点自己擅长的事？

lines.en: : That...can just make you feel good about yourself? Since when?
lines.zh: : 那样……就能让自己感觉良好了吗？从什么时候开始的？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready37
: Always for me! Like when I score a sweet goal or beat a personal best time around the track! I always think, “Darn, Miku! You’re pretty awesome!” or somethin’ like that.
lines.zh: : 对我来说一直都可以啊！比如我进了个漂亮的球，或者在跑道上破了个人最好成绩！我总会想「好家伙，Miku！你可真了不起！」之类的。

lines.en: : Really gets your blood pumpin’ when you see the...fruits of your improvement or whatever, ya know?
lines.zh: : 看到自己进步的……成果什么的，确实会让人热血沸腾，你懂吧？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不懂。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, never mind then.
lines.zh: : 那当我没说吧。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready38
: Okay! And now onto...my good pal Molly’s competition! Woohoo! Everybody give a round of applause to Molly!
lines.zh: : 好！接下来轮到……我的好伙伴 Molly 的比赛！哇哦哦！大家给 Molly 鼓个掌！

lines.en: : Mwahahah! Please, please! You all flatter me! Cease this commotion at once or mine ears shan't hear the challenge being issued!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈！请，请！诸位过誉了！快停下这骚动，否则我这双耳朵就听不到接下来发布的挑战了！

lines.en: : No one is clapping.
lines.zh: : 没有人在鼓掌。

lines.en: : No one in {i}this{/i} realm. The spirit realm is another story entirely. Oh, if only you could hear it, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : {i}这个{/i}次元里没有。灵界可完全是另一回事。哦，剑道公主，你要是能听见就好了。

lines.en: : My ancestors cry out about the wonderful quest I’ll receive this year! Could Molly MacCormack remain undefeated in the Super Mega Ultimate Dorm Wars?!
lines.zh: : 我的祖先正在为我今年将要领受的美妙任务而呼号！Molly MacCormack 能在超级无敌究极宿舍大战中保持不败吗？！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready39
: Of course she can! Because her challenge will be something {i}else{/i} she excels in! Such has been the pattern for the rest!
lines.zh: : 当然能！因为她的挑战一定是{i}另一样{/i}她擅长的东西！其余的人都是这个套路！

lines.en: : And with victories in both D&D and video games already under my belt, this challenge must either involve anime, manga, or...something we shouldn’t be speaking about in class!
lines.zh: : 而我既然已经在龙与地下城和电子游戏上拿过胜利，这次的挑战必定与动画、漫画或者……某种不该在课堂上说出口的东西有关！

lines.en: : I wonder which one it will be.
lines.zh: : 会是哪一种呢。

lines.en: : In this year's Dorm Wars, Molly and Rin will be having a beach-style cook-off. Whoever makes the best dish wins.
lines.zh: : 在本届宿舍大战中，Molly 和 Rin 要比一场海滩风格的厨艺对决。谁做的菜更好吃，谁就赢。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready40
: At last...the time has finally come for me to share {i}my{/i} powers with you.
lines.zh: : 终于……是时候让你们见识{i}我的{/i}力量了。

lines.en: : You have done well thus far, Emerald Guardian. But the world is in my hands now. And my hands are large and resistant to heat from years of being burned in the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 迄今为止你做得不错，翡翠守护者。可现在世界掌握在我的手里。而我的这双手很大，并且在厨房里被烫伤了那么多年，早就耐高温了。

lines.en: : I will make you a goddess of the stove before you know it.
lines.zh: : 我会让你在不知不觉间成为灶台女神。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready41
: You and Molly, huh? Is that, like...gonna be weird for you?
lines.zh: : 你和 Molly 啊？那对你来说……会不会有点怪？

lines.en: : Hm? Not really. I think we’re cool now.
lines.zh: : 嗯？还好。我觉得我们现在已经没事了。

lines.en: : If anything, the weird part is going to be cooking. My moms always handled that stuff. All I can do is microwave cup-noodles and I doubt that’ll get me anywhere unless Tsuneyo is the judge.
lines.zh: : 要说怪的话，怪的是要做饭。一直是我的妈妈们负责那些事的。我只会用微波炉泡杯面，除非评委是 Tsuneyo，否则我怀疑那玩意儿帮不上我什么忙。

lines.en: : I can...help teach you some things, Rin. I had to cook for myself a lot when I lived alone.
lines.zh: : 我可以……教你一些东西，Rin。我一个人住的时候，不得不经常自己做饭。

lines.en: : I’m not...the best, but...I’m sure I can teach you {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我算不上……最好，不过……我肯定能教你点{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready42
: Guess that just leaves...the rest of our group, Yasu, and Ayane then. Anyone have any guesses on what the remaining contests will be?
lines.zh: : 那么剩下的就是……我们这组其余的人、Yasu 和 Ayane 了。有人猜得到剩下的比赛是什么吗？

lines.en: : Hopefully...nothing that...will put me in the spotlight again...
lines.zh: : 但愿……不是什么……会让我再次成为焦点的东西……

lines.en: : I’m still a little...worn out from the fashion show...
lines.zh: : 我还没从那场时装秀里……缓过来……

lines.en: : Sana, that was like two years ago.
lines.zh: : Sana，那都像是两年前的事了。

lines.en: : It takes...a long time for me to...recover...
lines.zh: : 我……需要很长时间……才能恢复……

lines.en: : Okay, let’s see here...What else do we have, Makoto? Our gals in the back ain’t had much excitement tossed their way just yet.
lines.zh: : 好吧，让我看看……还有什么来着，Makoto？后排的姑娘们还没被扔到什么刺激的东西呢。

lines.en: : No, Uta. It appears they have not. So why not shake things up a bit by announcing a writing contest between Futaba and Nodoka?!
lines.zh: : 是啊，Uta。看来确实没有。那不如来点刺激的——宣布 Futaba 和 Nodoka 的写作对决吧！

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready43
: Well, it’s been nice knowing you all.
lines.zh: : 那么，很高兴认识大家。

lines.en: : No way, Futaba! I think you’ve got a shot at this! Everything Nodoka writes is really weird and offputting!
lines.zh: : 不会吧，Futaba！我觉得你是有机会的！Nodoka 写的东西都又怪又让人不适！

lines.en: : Plus, we don’t even know what the genre is yet. If it’s fantasy, you’ve {i}totally{/i} got this. Nodoka sucks at that stuff.
lines.zh: : 再说，我们还不知道体裁是什么呢。如果是奇幻，你{i}绝对{/i}稳赢。Nodoka 最不擅长那个了。

lines.en: : Also, since writing and the beach are two things that shouldn’t ever really go together since one is fun and the other is kinda lame, we’ve decided to make this writing contest a {i}scary-story{/i} contest!
lines.zh: : 另外，既然写作和海滩本来就不该凑到一块儿——一个有趣，一个有点无聊——我们决定把这场写作比赛办成{i}鬼故事{/i}比赛！

lines.en: : That’s right! Whoever comes up with the creepiest, most terrifying tale will be crowned the victor.
lines.zh: : 没错！谁讲出最阴森、最恐怖的故事，谁就是胜者。

lines.en: : Is that good? I can’t tell if that genre is good. You got this? You got this. Maybe? Yeah. You totally do. I think?
lines.zh: : 这个好吗？我拿不准这个体裁算不算好。你行吗？你行的。大概？对。你肯定行。我觉得？

lines.en: : Again, it’s been nice knowing you all.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，很高兴认识大家。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready44
: I don’t...read very much, but...you can borrow some of my...movies if...it will help you...understand the...genre...
lines.zh: : 我不怎么……看书，不过……你可以借我的一些……电影，如果……能帮你……理解这个……体裁的话……

lines.en: : That’s right! Sana’s totally into all of that stuff! I’m sure she has a ton that will help with Futaba’s journey to become creepier than Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 对啊！Sana 超迷这些东西的！我敢肯定她有一大堆能帮 Futaba 变得比 Nodoka 更阴森的存货。

lines.en: : Speaking of Nodoka, you planning on weighing in on this at all back there?
lines.zh: : 说到 Nodoka，你在后面就没什么想说的吗？

lines.en: : Hm? Yes. Right. Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 嗯？有。对。宿舍大战。

lines.en: : She’s just...in the zone right now. And thank you, Sana. I can drop by your room later and pick a few things out.
lines.zh: : 她只是……现在进入状态了而已。谢谢你，Sana。我待会儿可以去你房间挑几部。

lines.en: : O...Okay...that sounds...good to me...
lines.zh: : 好……好的……听着……挺不错的……

lines.en: : Hey, since only Otoha and Yasu are left from the second floor and Sana’s already gone up against Yasu...that means you two are gonna have to compete right?
lines.zh: : 嘿，二楼只剩下 Otoha 和 Yasu，而 Sana 已经跟 Yasu 比过了……那岂不是你们俩要比？

lines.en: : What do you think the contest will be? Something music related? Maybe another test of courage to go along with the scary stuff?
lines.zh: : 你们觉得会是什么项目？跟音乐有关的？还是配合恐怖主题的又一次试胆？

lines.en: : Who even knows at this point? I’ll be happy so long as it’s nothing embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 事到如今谁知道呢？只要不是什么丢人的东西，我就谢天谢地了。

lines.en: : S...Same here...I don’t...want to spend...another two years...recovering...
lines.zh: : 我……也是……我可不想……再花两年……恢复……

lines.en: : Let’s see, let’s see...notes, notes...ah! Found it!
lines.zh: : 让我看看，让我看看……笔记，笔记……啊！找到了！

lines.en: : Sana and Otoha will be competing to see who can make Sensei’s heart flutter the most with a love confession.
lines.zh: : Sana 和 Otoha 要比的是，谁能用一段爱的告白让老师的心跳得最厉害。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready45
: L...Love?!
: That’s impossible! He doesn’t have a heart! How can we make flutter what does not exist?!
lines.zh: : 这不可能！他没有心！要怎么让一个不存在的东西怦然跳动？！

lines.en: : Thanks, Otoha. Appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢了啊，Otoha。多谢夸奖。

lines.en: : Just look at him! Pretending to have feelings! Who does he think he is?!
lines.zh: : 你看看他！装得跟有感情似的！他以为自己是谁啊？！

lines.en: : Well, damn. Didn’t see that challenge coming.
lines.zh: : 靠，真没想到会来这么一项挑战。

lines.en: : Yeah...that sounds...just as dangerous as the date war...doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……听起来……跟约会战争一样危险……不是吗？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready46
: What? No. No, no, no. Like, it obviously doesn’t have to be {i}real.{/i} It’s just another writing thing.
lines.zh: : 什么？不。不不不。这个显然不必是{i}真的{/i}嘛。只是又一个写作项目而已。

lines.en: : Yeah, but the best confessions come from the heart. Which means if you don’t feel anything, you’re at a disadvantage.
lines.zh: : 话是这么说，可最好的告白都是发自内心的。也就是说，如果你什么感觉都没有，你就处在劣势。

lines.en: : But hey, I only have a 50%% success rate when it comes to confessions, so don’t go looking to me for advice.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，我告白的成功率只有 50%%，所以别指望我给什么建议。

lines.en: : Hahah...guess I’m just pretty screwed then, huh? What with me being so devoted to Rin and everything.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……那看来我是彻底完蛋了，对吧？毕竟我对 Rin 那么死心塌地的。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready47
: Aww...girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 哇哦……女朋友。

lines.en: : Are you okay, Sana? You look...very flushed right now.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Sana？你现在看起来……脸很红。

lines.en: : Yeah...just...
: Words...
: Hard...
lines.zh: : 说不出来……

lines.en: : I agree, Sana. Words hard.
lines.zh: : 我同意，Sana。话很难说。

lines.en: : Words very hard indeed.
lines.zh: : 话确实是相当的难说。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready48
: Well, ladies and...Sensei!  And Molly.
lines.zh: : 那么，女士们，还有……老师！以及 Molly。

lines.en: : But, before we get to that, we’d also like to let everyone know that the results from Miss Watabe’s poetry contest will be revealed at the beach as well!
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我们还要告诉大家，Watabe 小姐的诗歌比赛结果也会在海滩上公布！

lines.en: : So if you’re one of the people who entered that and are looking forward to whatever weird prize she’s offering for it, stay tuned because {i}you{/i} might very well be chosen!
lines.zh: : 所以如果{i}你{/i}参加了那个比赛，正期待着她提供的什么古怪奖品，敬请期待，因为被选中的很可能就是你！

lines.en: : So, without further ado...
lines.zh: : 那么，闲话少说……

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready49
: The last competition for this year’s Dorm Wars will be Ayane vs Yasu!
lines.zh: : 本届宿舍大战的最后一场比赛是 Ayane 对 Yasu！

lines.en: : But {i}what{/i} will they be competing in, Makoto?!
lines.zh: : 可她们要比{i}什么{/i}呢，Makoto？！

lines.en: : Great question, Uta! They’ll be competing in-
lines.zh: : 问得好，Uta！她们要比的是——

lines.en: : The {i}ultimate{/i} test of courage! Being dropped off in the middle of nowhere with no resources and having to find their way back!
lines.zh: : {i}终极{/i}试胆！把她们丢到荒无人烟的地方，不给任何资源，让她们自己找路回来！

lines.en: : Another extremely dangerous and borderline illegal suggestion! Great job again, girls!
lines.zh: : 又是一个极度危险、游走在违法边缘的提议！干得漂亮，两位！

lines.en: : Uta, if you interrupt me one more time, I’m going to break your glasses.
lines.zh: : Uta，你要是再打断我一次，我就把你的眼镜掰断。

lines.en: : Ah! As a fellow glasses-girl, I’m shook! You should know better, Makoto!
lines.zh: : 啊！同为眼镜娘，我惊呆了！你应该更懂才对，Makoto！

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready50
: Ah?! Wha?! Hah?! Who?!
scene omganotherwaralready51
: Oh...Yasu. It’s just you. You scared me.
lines.zh: : 哦……是 Yasu 啊。原来是你。吓死我了。

lines.en: : You were scared even before I approached you. I could hear it in your heart.
lines.zh: : 早在我靠近你之前，你就已经害怕了。我从你的心跳里听得出来。

lines.en: : You could...what?
lines.zh: : 你听得出来……什么？

lines.en: : Is something troubling you?
lines.zh: : 有什么事在困扰你吗？

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready52
: Uhh...that’s...not really something I have the time to get into right now...
lines.zh: : 呃……那……我现在实在没时间细说……

lines.en: : Because if something is troubling you, I know someone who can help.
lines.zh: : 因为如果有什么困扰着你，我认识一个人能帮上忙。

lines.en: : He is a wonderful person. So full of wisdom. With the answers to every question you could ever ask.
lines.zh: : 他是个很棒的人。充满智慧。你问得出的任何问题，他都有答案。

lines.en: : I’m...not really interested in converting or anything...
lines.zh: : 我……对入教什么的可没兴趣……

lines.en: : I am referring to our teacher.
lines.zh: : 我说的是我们的老师。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready53
: You...are? Really?
lines.zh: : 你……说的是他？真的？

lines.en: : Yes. He is a wonderful person. And he finds himself just as lost as you do more often than you’d believe.
lines.zh: : 是的。他是个很棒的人。而他迷失其中的次数，多得你未必肯相信。

lines.en: : Your hearts match at this very moment. And though it may not seem it, you’re more connected than you’ve ever been before.
lines.zh: : 你们的心此刻是同频的。尽管看上去不像，但你们之间的联系，比以往任何时候都更深。

lines.en: scene omganotherwaralready54
: But how long will it last, I wonder?...
lines.zh: : 可我好奇的是，这份联系能持续多久呢？……

lines.en: : How long will...it last? What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 能持续……多久？你这话是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……

lines.en: : Your life is about to become very difficult. And few pass the trials they are handed.
lines.zh: : 你的人生即将变得非常艰难。而能熬过所经受的试炼的人，寥寥无几。

lines.en: : Will you be one of those few?
lines.zh: : 你会是那少数人之一吗？

lines.en: : Or will you become more lost than ever before?
lines.zh: : 还是会变得比以往任何时候都更加迷失？

lines.en: : Okaaaaay. You can back up now.
lines.zh: : 好——了。你现在可以后退了。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to our competition.
lines.zh: : 我很期待我们的比赛。

lines.en: scene black
: Huh?...Were we...competing in something?
lines.zh: : 哈？……我们……有要比什么吗？

lines.en: The assignment of the third annual Dorm Wars match-ups comes to a close.
lines.zh: 第三届宿舍大战的对阵分配就此落定。

lines.en: I exit the room with an elevated heart-rate and the fear that this contest will be worse than the last.
lines.zh: 我走出教室，心跳加速，满心恐惧：这一届恐怕会比上一届更糟。

lines.en: I can not tell you why.
lines.zh: 我说不出为什么。

lines.en: And I will not pretend to be excited for it.
lines.zh: 我也不会假装自己对此感到期待。
